video_title: What If the Internet Disappeared for 30 Days? Cash Isn't Enough
video_description: A self-contained fictional five-minute scenario following delivery worker Ada and shopkeeper Milo through thirty days without routable public Internet. Electricity and local networks remain; radio can work, while telephone availability varies by system. Clearly label the premise as hypothetical, not a forecast or a realistic single kill switch. Follow failed orders, payment friction, supply coordination, paper routes, verified notice boards and community radio, then a gradual reconnection. Cool layered city, physical network links and packets, an offline checkout, animated supply chain and radio desk. Suspenseful but humane; the surprise is that coordination matters as much as cash.
